Riverside Plumbing, a licensed plumber in Springfield, Illinois

We are a family-owned plumbing company serving Springfield, Illinois since 2004. Our licensed plumbers handle leaking pipes, clogged drains, water heater replacement, sump pumps, fixture installation and full bathroom repiping. We answer the phone 24 hours a day and offer same-day appointments for most repairs. Every job is backed by a written warranty and upfront pricing, so you know the cost before we start work. Call (217) 555-0142 or visit us at 48 River Rd, Springfield, IL 62701.

Services

  • Drain cleaning and hydro jetting
  • Water heater repair and replacement, tank and tankless
  • Leak detection and pipe repair
  • Sump pump installation and battery backup systems
  • Bathroom and kitchen remodel plumbing

Hours

Monday to Friday, 7am to 6pm. Saturday, 8am to 2pm. Emergency calls are answered 24 hours a day, every day of the year including holidays.

Why customers choose us

Licensed and insured in the State of Illinois. Transparent, fixed pricing quoted before work begins. More than one thousand five-star reviews from neighbours across Sangamon County. We treat your home like our own, wear boot covers indoors and clean up after every job. Because we stock the most common parts on our trucks, the large majority of repairs are finished in a single visit rather than needing a second appointment for parts.

Common questions

Do you offer emergency service?

Yes. We answer the phone 24 hours a day, every day of the year, including holidays.

What areas do you serve?

Springfield and the surrounding Sangamon County communities, usually within 40 minutes of downtown.

How much does a service call cost?

We quote a fixed price before starting work, so you know the cost up front. There is no charge if you decline the quote.
